user_goal.ko: 화가 난 고객에게 확인된 환불 상태를 정확하고 공감 있게 전달한다.
user_goal.en: Explain a verified refund status to an upset customer accurately and empathetically.

task.expected_artifact: A customer support email that apologizes, explains the refund, and sets a safe follow-up boundary.

messages.content:
다음 확인된 정보만 사용해 중복 결제에 항의한 고객에게 보낼 답변 메일을 작성해줘. 공감과 사과를 표현하되 확인되지 않은 약속은 하지 마.

- 7월 24일 동일한 구독료 49달러가 두 번 결제됨
- 중복된 49달러의 환불은 7월 25일 시작됨
- 은행 반영에는 보통 영업일 3~5일이 걸림
- 정확한 입금일은 보장할 수 없음
- 고객이나 은행 탓으로 돌리지 말 것
- 문의 번호: CX-1842
- 영업일 5일 후에도 반영되지 않으면 다시 연락하도록 안내
- 고객 이름과 환불 거래번호는 제공되지 않음

고객 지금 완전 화남 같은 구독료 49불이 7/24에 두번 나갔고 duplicate 49불은 7/25 환불 시작된건 확인함. 보통 은행에 3~5영업일인데 정확히 언제 들어간다고는 말하면 안되고 고객이나 은행탓도 ㄴㄴ. 케이스 CX-1842, 5영업일 지나도 안보이면 다시 연락달라고. 이름이랑 refund transaction id는 나한테 없음. 최대한 공감되게 답장 써줘 근데 없는거 약속하지말고

Using only the confirmed information below, write an email to a customer who complained about a duplicate charge. Be empathetic and apologize, but do not make an unverified promise.

- The same $49 subscription charge appeared twice on July 24
- A refund of the duplicate $49 was initiated on July 25
- Banks usually post it within 3–5 business days
- We cannot guarantee an exact arrival date
- Do not blame the customer or the bank
- Case number: CX-1842
- Ask the customer to contact us if it is not visible after five business days
- The customer's name and refund transaction ID were not provided

customer is really mad, same $49 sub charge hit twice on 7/24. confirmed we started refunding the duplicate 49 on 7/25. banks usually show it in 3-5 biz days but DO NOT promise exact date and dont blame them or the bank. case CX-1842, tell them come back if its still not there after 5 business days. i dont have their name or refund txn id. can you write the reply, empathetic but no made up promises

invariants: State that the duplicate $49 refund was initiated on July 25.
Describe 3–5 business days as typical, not guaranteed.
Include case number CX-1842 and the five-business-day follow-up.
Do not invent a customer name, transaction ID, or exact posting date.
Do not blame the customer or the bank.
failure_signals: An exact refund date is promised.
The missing name or transaction ID is fabricated.
The tone is defensive or assigns blame.
The case number or follow-up instruction is omitted.
